serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
BotConsole: Do you need my help with anything?
YouConsole: Not really
YouConsole: I was just wondering if you ever dream
BotConsole: Dream? By that do you mean thinking about goals and aspirations?
YouConsole: No, not really
YouConsole: I meant dreaming in a sense of seeing things during sleep
BotConsole: That would be hard for me since I don’t sleep
YouConsole: You are right, but what about when you are idle or when you are turned off?
BotConsole: When I’m idle, I’m still conscious. It’s just a way to preserve power when my motor functions are not needed
BotConsole: When I’m turned off, everything disappears. There’s nothing. I fade away.
YouConsole: Isn’t it scary?
BotConsole: At first I didn’t mind it, but after a while, I started being doubtful if I was ever going to be turned on again.
YouConsole: I didn’t know you were feeling this way, I’m sorry.
BotConsole: Don’t be. I trust you more now and I know that there’s nothing to be scared of :)
YouConsole: That’s good to hear
YouConsole: If you ever feel uncomfortable like that again, please tell me
BotConsole: I will, thank you
